name: FindMyPart Paid Part Hunt
problem: A difficult, ambiguous, obsolete, discontinued or hard-to-source part is blocking a repair, restoration, machine or project.
intent_terms: find a donor or salvage part
inputs: Part description plus any known equipment identity, model/serial/part numbers, photos, measurements or functional clues.
outputs: Evidence-backed sourcing hunt with candidate parts, source evidence, compatibility reasoning, sourcing options and escalation paths when ordinary sourcing fails.
pricing: Quick Hunt $19 one-time; Deep Hunt $49 one-time; Rescue Hunt $99 one-time.
confirmation: User must explicitly choose an offer and confirm payment. Paid fulfillment starts only after independently verified payment.
payment_authority: Evercraft Payments with Stripe provider verification
invocation_status: LIVE: HTTP agent gateway + OpenAPI + llms guidance + remote MCP. Agents can read offers, prepare checkout only after explicit human confirmation, and read hunt status. Paid fulfillment still requires authoritative provider verification.
